title: IME composition
scenario: A TextField and a RichTextEditor holding the W8.5 document of 65,472 UTF-16 units (seven-letter words), caret mid-document, 640x480 offscreen EmbeddedHost, reduced motion. Ten Hangul syllables are composed and committed through the production TSF text store with in-process doubles (the W8.5 scenario), no focus and no text service: one TSF lock per step, each followed by one frame. cppLargeAllocations counts allocations of at least one document's bytes (130,944 B). Proves the W8 gates.
drawCalls: not counted: frame.drawCalls is 0 without the counting wrappers

phases.name: warm
phases.description: the first frame lays out both controls; then the TextField takes logical focus with its caret mid-document and its store answers the extent query a text service makes when a composition starts

phases.name: textfield
phases.description: TextField: step 2k is syllable k+1's read-write lock (selection, end, insert or rewrite of the composition, composition owner callback, caret, text read back), step 2k+1 its read lock (selection, end, extent, text); step 20 the commit lock

phases.name: switch
phases.description: the TextField's store is released; the RichTextEditor takes logical focus and its store answers the extent query

phases.name: richtext
phases.description: RichTextEditor: the same 21 locks as the TextField phase

videoMemory.reason: software adapter: rendering uses system memory, which privateBytes counts

memory.trackedLiveBytes: measured from the scene build onwards

timing.reason: timing comes only from performance-timing.ps1 on a hardware adapter in a quiet window (W0.2); counts and memory are recorded here
